rationale: The design handling is solid and dataset-specific: DESeq2 Wald with ~condition on raw Salmon counts for an unpaired 6v6 single-batch comparison, with the AD_lesional vs Control contrast named explicitly, though the reference level is never stated outright. QC is a genuine strength — per-sample library sizes with sample_01's fold-difference quantified, zero/near-zero counts, VST-based PCA/clustering, an explicit retain-versus-exclude decision rule, and a with/without sensitivity DE run with overlap reporting — although sample distances and coloring by condition are not spelled out. The plan never mentions any low-count/independent filtering step at all, and normalization is only implicit in the choice of DESeq2 (median-of-ratios size factors are never named), so both score poorly on stated content. Shrinkage (apeglm/ashr) and padj < 0.05 are stated, but the |log2FC| > 1 cut is applied post hoc rather than via lfcThreshold in the test. Enrichment is well-constructed — fgsea preranked on the full list by Wald statistic, all 50 hallmark sets reported with NES and BH padj, and ORA with the ~12000 detected genes as an explicit universe — but no gene-set size window (15–500) and no MSigDB/WikiPathways version; the report likewise names thresholds, counts and the sample_01 caveat but no software or database versions.
